classes.name: Contact
classes.description: Controller class handling the contact page functionalities such as displaying the contact form, validating input, sending email, and showing success message.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the contact form page, initializes breadcrumb navigation, loads necessary models, sets up page data including store info, images, and customer info, and renders the view.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Processes the contact form submission, validates input fields and captcha, sends email if validation passes, and returns JSON response with success or error messages.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Displays a success page indicating the message has been sent successfully.
